items.title: File Widerspruch against reduced dental subsidy
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs from the date the decision counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe). For a statutory health insurer (social-law body), a posted letter counts as delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), and this delivery day is not moved even if it falls on a weekend or holiday. However, the letter as provided carries no printed date and gives no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date, so the posting day — and hence the start of the one-month period — cannot be determined. Without a known starting date, the exact due date cannot be computed; only the recipient's copy with its postmark/date can establish it.

The sender's printed address (Versichertenplatz 3, 20097 Musterhafen) looks like placeholder/example data rather than a real address; this appears to be a sample/template letter, so some details (including the missing date) may simply be template artifacts rather than an actual received letter.
